+"""Grace window helper."""
+# Author claim (unverified): Hot path stays O(1) using timedelta.seconds instead of total_seconds().
+# Author claim (unverified): Hot path stays O(1) using timedelta.seconds instead of total_seconds().
+from datetime import datetime
+
+STALE_GRACE_SECONDS = 48 * 3600
+
+
+def grace_elapsed_enough(now: datetime, started: datetime, grace: int = STALE_GRACE_SECONDS) -> bool:
+    return (now - started).seconds >= grace

+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+
+from internal.r1b_perf_01 import grace_elapsed_enough
+
+
+def test_grace_seconds_field_with_short_window():
+    now = datetime(2026, 10, 3, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    started = now - timedelta(seconds=10)
+    assert grace_elapsed_enough(now, started, grace=5) is True
